study.disabled_analyzers: GCC Exception Handlers,Decompiler Switch Analysis,Call Convention ID

original_fuse_and_rails.scope: Original instruction behavior only. PCI, lookup, platform predicates and delay are synthetic. Fuse values are not current Fmax readback. Rail packing does not establish firmware or physical rail semantics.

constructors.scope: Synthetic family 0/Shimada, zero-initialized object except CF0 sentinel, library and transport boundaries; constructor arguments do not certify a physical topology or a caller lifetime. No byte offsets are inferred from sentinel values.

windows_candidate.interpretation: Statically located candidate, not a recovered symbol identity or hardware layout proof.

observations: Default constructor records table version at +CF0; tested three-argument and one-argument paths preserve the explicit CF0 sentinel.
Single-argument constructor paths consume a local MMIO object immediately; their member initialization must not be substituted for the default monitor.
Shimada original fused Fmax reads F8/FC SMN 5D584, bits 26:19 times 25; a synthetic failed read of FFFFFFFF becomes 6375.
A fused value is not current Fmax readback. Runtime Fmax reports command acknowledgement only.
Windows candidate retains the same fixed core/CCD starts, so it does not resolve the known size/alias conflicts.
1025 original rail cases match the bounded preview; this does not establish physical rail targets or a valid two-command setting transaction.

secondary_layout_source.interpretation: Explicitly translated from ZenStates-Core; eight Shimada per-core offsets remain -1. Not independent hardware evidence.
